build_videoprism_model: build a VideoPrism model by name using get_model with a model name or Hugging Face ID
load_pretrained_weights: load pretrained VideoPrism weights from Hugging Face or a local checkpoint path
load_text_tokenizer: load a SentencePiece text tokenizer by name from the configured text tokenizer registry
tokenize_texts: tokenize a batch of texts with padding and return token ids and padding masks
check_model_availability: check whether a VideoPrism model name or Hugging Face ID is available in the registry
